notes.title: Numeral Strike Demo
notes.content: [p]Slay or Fall has officially left early access, and the developer is not standing still - there is a new game ahead: [b]Numeral Strike[/b]![/p][p]This is an unusual hybrid of [b]puzzle and roguelike[/b], where the key to victory is attentiveness and strategy. The player has to close pairs of numbers on the field: the same or adding up to 10. But for each number, items and abilities are unlocked - both for the hero and for the enemies. Some of them activate a sword or shield, others - strengthen the enemy.[/p][p]Every decision has a price: moves are spent, the field is updated. To defeat opponents, you will have to combine logic, tactical thinking and the ability to take risks.[/p][p]Although Numeral Strike is not the spiritual ancestor of Slay or Fall, the author of the game constantly recommends that you check out the new game![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720020/Numeral_Strike_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.9
notes.content: [h2]List of changes:[/h2][p]Added new unit - [b]Goblin Flesh[/b]. Available if you have "Tyrant" relations with goblins. Moves slowly, does not attack. Deals a lot of damage when killed, exploding[/p][p]Added new text event - [b]Graveyard[/b][/p][p]Added 2 new political events[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.8
notes.content: [h2]List of changes:[/h2][p]1. Added 6 new political events[/p][p]2. Added a new text event - [b]Dark Star[/b][/p][p]3. Fixed a number of bugs that were found on the old version of the game. Thank you for reporting them![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.7
notes.content: [h2]List of changes:[/h2][p]1. Added the last 12th hero - this is the [b]Sadist[/b]. A dangerous hero who strengthens allies and does not allow them to rest at halts! Every decrease in morale is good for her![/p][p]2. Added a new hero preset: Oppressed. These are two Monsters and one Sadist[/p][p]3. [b]Spiders[/b] and [b]Yeti[/b] can now appear during the search for artifacts. There is an achievement for killing the Yeti![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes: [/h1]
1. Added 6 new political events
2. Added a new text event - Lost Ally
3. Minstrel takes the minimum damage when spinning
4. Hunger still deals damage to heroes, but does not finish them off on 2 edges of death
5. Fixed a number of bugs that were found on the old version of the game. Thank you for reporting them!

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.5
notes.content:
During the existence of the game, I received a lot of negative reviews and refunds due to poor translation into other languages. Well, this update begins the journey to improve the translation! A content update is expected in the future, this update affects the improvement of existing events in the game.
[h1]List of changes: [/h1]
1. Improved the [b]English[/b] translation of the game
2. Improved the [b]Japanese[/b] translation of the game
3. Improved existing [b]sound effects[/b] and added new ones
4. Fixed a number of bugs that were found in the old version of the game. Thank you for reporting them!

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.4.4
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes: [/h1]
1. Added new text events [b]Underground Sage[/b] and [b]Preparation[/b]
2. Added a new special unit - [b]Dark Knight[/b]! This is a former cruel hero who has defected to your side. To use his skills, you need to get the corresponding achievement with betrayal. In the event [b]Preparation[/b] you can, oddly enough, prepare the Dark Knight! Since the cruel hero can be either a man or a woman, in the event you can choose the gender of your subordinate yourself! Be careful, the art for the Dark Knight is quite creepy... After all, he is a former [u]cruel[/u] hero!
3. Added a new unit - [b]Anti-Magic Tower[/b]. It is available if the lizard people see you as a Tyrant. The unit is narrowly focused, but can help beginner players who just can't beat the Cleric or the Ranger!
4. Added a new item - [b]Diary[/b]. When you pick it up, the next event will definitely be Preparation.
5. Fixed a number of bugs and shortcomings. Thank you for reporting them!

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.4.1
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. Added a new hero, the Monster. A new hero preset, the Lepers, was added along with it
2. Improved backgrounds on some text events
3. Fixed a number of bugs and shortcomings

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.3.8
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. After opening the Seeds of Darkness, the player gets access to [b]Faction Statuses[/b]. These are randomly appearing changes that affect the construction of tactics and the run. Your faithful Advisor will explain everything to you in more detail!
2. The development of special units has begun, which become available only when the faction is in a special state:
[olist]
[*] Sniper - available if the Ratmen see you as a Tyrant or Partner. Unlimited attack range, long reload with high damage. Selects a target by the least amount of health
[*] Witch - available if the Occultists see you as a Fool or Madman. Throws potions that heal allies (20 health) and reduce the heroes' defense by 1 (up to negative values)
[/olist]
3. A new text event has been added - Cave Witch. It is here that you can unlock the Witch as a unit (or burn her, hee hee)
4. Added a new text event - Sneaky Meeting. And again, the ratmen are interfering with your brilliant plans! How much longer can you tolerate them?!
5. Added new achievements related to previous points
6. Added a new item Book of Revelations: Significantly increases the chance of statuses appearing
7. Added a new preset for Lord Politician - starts with positive relations with all factions and a new item Book of Revelations
8. Rendered the background for the tutorial with goblins
9. Fixed bugs sent in the discord channel. Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Slay or Fall Soundtrack
notes.content:
Our Soundtrack is out on Steam! More than 25 tracks, which will be updated over time! If you like our project and want to support the developers, buying the soundtrack is a great way to do it!
Since the tracks in the game are divided into two parts (intro and loop), to create tracks of your own length, the divided parts of the music are saved in local files (Optional for loop folder) in wav format.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3263780/Slay_or_Fall_Soundtrack/]Link to store page[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.3.4
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. Added a new hero - the Guardian. Opens after completing the global plot. Along with him, new achievements were added
2. Reworked tutorial. The player will have to follow the journey of disguised goblins who pretend to be heroes. In the future, a separate art for the training will be drawn.
3. Fixed a number of shortcomings and bugs.

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. At the start of the run, you can now choose between Corridors, Politics, and Artifact Search
2. Added two new text events: Wandering Musicians and the Uprising of Hatred
3. Added several political events
4. Two new items appeared in the settings: changing the speed of the talker and automatic text skip
5. Added a new hero preset - Caravan
6. The initial population of ratmen has been reduced by 100 on almost all lord presets
7. Fixed a number of bugs and shortcomings. Thanks for the feedback!
8. Added a new branch to the Stream event.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.2.7 & 0.1.0.2.8
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes[/h2]
1. Heroes with the Desperate trait lose 5 sanity each event. Heroes with the Sickly trait lose 5% health each event. If the check on the Mistrustful hero is successful, the party's morale decreases by 5.
2. Goblins' ability has been changed: Gives 40 coins. You only get 20 coins back, but your relations with the goblins are -5
3. The balance in the Best Killer event has been adjusted
4. There are now inscriptions indicating whether the check has been successfully passed or not
5. Added 7 new political events!
6. Changed the ability of Occultists in text events:
You see which parameters are affected by your choice in text events (passive)
When activated for 15 mana, you see upcoming checks within one text event
7. Correction of shortcomings and bugs

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.2.6
notes.content:
In addition to fixing bugs, the update mainly affects the balance of the game
List of balance changes:
1. Changed relations with ratmen and lizards on the Lord Warlord preset
2. Added a new preset Schemer
3. To avoid endless battles, the player's units increase their attack with each minute of battle
4. To achieve victory in the text event "Goblin Village", you must pass a check for Pain or Despair
5. In the text event "Occultists' Refuge", the cost of the sacrifice option has been increased
6. The attack of ratmen crossbowmen has been increased to 20
7. The ability of ratmen in text events has been changed to "At the end of the event, with an equal chance, provisions -1, coins +10 or morale -5"
8. The ability of lizards in text events now has a small limitation and is less dependent on relations with lizards

Thank you for feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.0.2.3, 0.1.0.2.4 and 0.1.0.2.5
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. Added a separate volume bar for the speaker, fixed moments when the speaker voiced editing tags
2. Added new achievements for hero presets when completing on 3 seeds of darkness
3. Added other new achievements
4. Added a new dialogue that completes the global plot
5. Fixed a bug in the final battle, during which the purchase of units was unavailable
6. A number of corrections in the text of dialogues
7. Fixed the cluster sound when spawning units
8. Fixed game crashes on the pass
9. Fixed a bug with negative population
10. Fixed the display of artifacts in the Library and Cemetery events
11. Other minor fixes that I forgot to voice!

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.0.2.2
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
1. Fixed issuing achievements during the game
2. Adjusted the manager's work (inscriptions on the left when changing parameters)
3. Added display of damage received by heroes
4. Fixed the animation of the heroes' walking when reaching the exit
5. Rebalanced the ghost unit
6. Other minor game fixes
